question: In a certain code language, 'IGNORE' is written as 'REONGI'. How will 'JUNIOR' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'IGNORE' is written as 'REONGI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b453486b74d92acf8c888528fd896a9d70302db716d28e266e8502862294f0a.png] 

Similarly,

'JUNIOR' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6b374909c4bcc41683262471e345f65a641850be8d71b1e8445bf620330a54.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ORINUJ".**
